template.title: Project report template
template.summary: Chooses the project template the report uses.
template.description: A project template's file name in the project's templates folder, without .md; choose uses the one the question names, the project's only one, or asks which.

document_tokens.title: Text read per document
document_tokens.summary: Sets how much of each document is read.
document_tokens.description: The approximate number of tokens read from each document: its card, its opening and the passages closest to what the template asks for. More reads more of each document and takes longer.

max_documents.title: Most documents
max_documents.summary: Caps the number of documents one report reads.
max_documents.description: Documents beyond this number, in path order, are left out and the report says so.

repair_attempts.title: Section repairs
repair_attempts.summary: Sets how often a section that misses its limits is rewritten.
repair_attempts.description: A section outside its word or item limits is rewritten up to this many times; the report notes any section still outside them.

confirmation.title: Confirm large reports
confirmation.summary: Controls when the tool asks before reading many documents.
confirmation.description: With when_large, a report needing more model calls than the large-report limit shows an estimated time and offers a shorter reading or cancelling first.

large_batches.title: Large-report limit
large_batches.summary: Sets how many model calls make a report large.
large_batches.description: A report above this number of model calls (one per document and one per section) asks for confirmation when confirmation is when_large.
